create_camera_object: create a Camera object with position, orientation, and intrinsic parameters like fx, fy, px, py
create_camera_with_pose: create a Camera object initialized with a pose_matrix for 3D scene reconstruction
camera_to_dict: call to_dict on a Camera object to extract all camera parameters into a dictionary
camera_get_pose: call get_pose on a Camera object to retrieve a copy of the camera pose matrix
review_camera_class: review the Camera class and its methods for storing camera projection and pose information
